about:
# Cleaner Loot Messages
The only purpose of this lightweight Addon is to reduce the loot messages to a minimum for a clearer information.
 

For example, your loot will be displayed as :
"+ [object_name]"

For a party member :
"+ [player_name] : [object_name]"

For a multiple craft of a party member :
"+ [player_name]: [object_name]x2 (craft)"

 

Work for group loot, craft, harvesting, reputation, XP ...

 

This addon is really light and has an extremely low impact on the game as it only redefine the way the message are formated.

![alt text](https://i.imgur.com/CJa6xrD.png)

## Current clients

| Client | Interface | Manifest |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retail 12.1.0 | 120100 | `_Mainline.toc` |
| Fresh / TBC Anniversary 2.5.6 | 20506 | `_TBC.toc` |
| MoP Classic 5.5.4 | 50504 | `_Mists.toc` |
| Forever | 16001 | `_Camelot.toc` |
| Classic Era / Hardcore / Season of Discovery 1.15.9 | 11509 | `_Vanilla.toc` |

Retail, Anniversary, MoP and Era versions were checked against Blizzard's EU
version service on 2026-10-09. Forever uses the same Interface value as
[ThreeCrownsGuild](https://github.com/luttman/ThreeCrownsGuild).
Legacy Wrath, Cataclysm and 3.3.5 manifests remain for existing users; their
clients have not been tested in this update.

The addon supports both `ChatFrameUtil.AddMessageEventFilter` and the older
`ChatFrame_AddMessageEventFilter`. Missing strings and incompatible format
placeholders keep Blizzard's original text. Reordered localized placeholders
also keep the original text; shortened labels such as `craft` remain English.
Silver and copper amounts use the standard yellow money color; gold keeps its
gold color. Blizzard's coin icons are preserved. English coin names in money
messages are replaced with the matching icons.
All leading `+` markers produced by the addon use green, independent of the
message's chat color. They inherit the chat frame's font; item and coin colors
remain separate.
Other localized text stays unchanged. Secret Retail messages are not
inspected or modified.

New appearance unlocks are displayed as `+ [Item name]`, preserving
the item's text, color and clickable link supplied by the client. Like loot and
skill messages, this replaces the client's message template directly, without
depending on a chat event. Missing or incompatible appearance formats stay unchanged.

Skill increases are shortened to `Axes = 27` or `Skinning = 50`, using the
client's skill name. Missing or incompatible skill message formats stay unchanged.

Quest-reward money and newly learned spells, abilities and passive effects use
`+ [reward or spell]`, preserving coin icons and spell links supplied by the client.
Comma-separated quest rewards such as `+ 1 Silver, 75 Copper` also use colored
coin amounts and icons. Messages with no space after `+` are supported.

## Custom chat renderers and EllesmereUIChat

Custom chat renderers can call `CleanerLootMessages.ConvertMoney(message, event)`
after their secret-value and string checks. Omit the event for history replay.
The formatter is idempotent; repeated calls do not duplicate icons or color codes.

EllesmereUIChat renders its own chat frames. In
`EllesmereUIChat_Engine.lua`, include the formatter in the availability check at
the start of the shared `DisplayText(msg, event)` function:

```lua
if not _abbrevOn and not _ccnOn and not ChatLinkIcons
    and not (CleanerLootMessages and CleanerLootMessages.ConvertMoney) then return msg end
```

After the existing secret-value and string checks, add this alongside the
ChatLinkIcons conversion, leaving channel abbreviation and name coloring intact:

```lua
if CleanerLootMessages and CleanerLootMessages.ConvertMoney and not _protActive then
    msg = CleanerLootMessages.ConvertMoney(msg, event)
end
```

This covers live messages, history rebuilds and session replay while skipping
protected mode. The Ellesmere engine patch is a separate local change; it is
not included in this addon's ZIP. Updating EllesmereUIChat may overwrite it.

## Testing

Automated tests use mocked WoW APIs. They do not replace testing in the game.
Before a release, enable `/console scriptErrors 1`, reload, and check self and
party loot, stack counts, crafting, money, currency, XP and reputation on each
client. On Retail, also test combat and `loadDeprecationFallbacks` disabled.
Collect a new appearance and check the shortened notification and its link.
Increase a weapon or profession skill and check the skill name and new rank.
Check that item links still open and that there are no Lua or blocked-action
errors, including alongside other chat addons.

## Releases

GitHub Actions checks Lua 5.1 syntax, runs compatibility tests and builds and
checks the installable ZIP on pushes to `main`, pull requests and tag pushes.
Only a tag push publishes. Existing tags such as `1.0.26` and tags prefixed
with `v` are both supported.

The workflow uses the same [BigWigs packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager)
as ThreeCrownsGuild. It creates a GitHub release with a universal ZIP containing
the `CleanerLootMessages` folder, sets the version from the tag and includes
client metadata in `release.json`. Tests and workflows are excluded.

GitHub publication uses the automatically supplied `GITHUB_TOKEN`. To publish
to the existing CurseForge project `677974`, set the repository Actions secret
`CF_API_KEY`. To also publish to the existing Wago project `Xb6XOxNp`, set
`WAGO_API_TOKEN`. Never put upload tokens in source files. Missing upload
tokens skip the corresponding service; GitHub releases still work.

After merging the changes, publish a new version from the repository:

```sh
git pull --ff-only
git tag -a 1.0.29 -m "Release 1.0.29"
git push origin 1.0.29
```

Download the attached `CleanerLootMessages-<version>.zip`, extract it into
`Interface/AddOns`, and replace the old addon folder when upgrading. GitHub's
automatically generated source archives are not the installable release ZIP.

## Addon policy review

The code was reviewed against [Blizzard's addon development policy](https://eu.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/wow-user-interface-add-on-development-policy/1642)
and [Midnight's addon restrictions](https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-gb/news/24244638/how-midnights-upcoming-game-changes-will-impact-combat-addons).
No policy violations were found in the repository: the code is public and
readable, has no paid feature gate, ads, in-game donation requests or offensive
content, sends no chat or addon network traffic, and does not automate gameplay
or bypass protected APIs. It changes message presentation and leaves secret
messages untouched. Blizzard retains the right to disable addon functionality.

This is a source review, not Blizzard approval or proof of performance in a
running client. Changes to Blizzard's global message strings can conflict with
other chat addons that parse those strings. The [existing CurseForge project](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/cleanerlootmessages)
lists its license as All Rights Reserved; the repository has no separate
license file. This update does not change the project's license.

releases.notes:
Install **CleanerLootMessages-1.0.30.zip** from the assets below. Extract its CleanerLootMessages folder into Interface/AddOns and replace the previous version.

- Use green for every leading `+` marker produced by the addon, keeping the chat frame's existing font.
- Display silver and copper amounts in standard yellow, preserving coin icons. Gold retains its gold color.
- Preserve item and spell link colors.
- Update previously formatted silver/copper history to the new colors without duplicating icons or color codes.

The separate EllesmereUIChat engine integration remains documented in the README and is not bundled in this ZIP. Updating EllesmereUIChat may overwrite the local engine patch.

Lua 5.1 compatibility and mocked DisplayText checks passed, including repeated formatting, secret values and protected mode. Full in-game testing across all supported clients was not performed.

Install **CleanerLootMessages-1.0.29.zip** from the assets below. Extract its CleanerLootMessages folder into Interface/AddOns and replace the previous version.

- Show English gold, silver and copper amounts as colored numbers with coin icons in money messages.
- Shorten quest-reward money and learned spells, abilities and passive effects to the existing `+` format, preserving spell links.
- Handle comma-separated quest rewards such as `+ 1 Silver, 75 Copper`, with or without a space after `+`.
- Expose `CleanerLootMessages.ConvertMoney(message, event)` for custom chat renderers. Repeated formatting does not duplicate icons or color codes.
- Document the EllesmereUIChat DisplayText integration, including secret-value checks and protected-mode behavior.

**EllesmereUIChat:** its separate engine patch is documented in the README and is not bundled in this ZIP. Updating EllesmereUIChat may overwrite the local engine patch.

Lua 5.1 compatibility checks and mocked tests of the actual local DisplayText function passed. The installable ZIP excludes tests and development files. These checks do not replace in-game testing on every supported client.

Install **CleanerLootMessages-1.0.28.zip** from the assets below. Extract its CleanerLootMessages folder into Interface/AddOns.

- Shorten weapon and profession skill gains, for example `Axes = 27` and `Skinning = 50`.
- Shorten new appearance unlocks to `+ [Item name]`, matching loot messages and preserving item colors and links.
- Use the native appearance message template for compatibility with Forever. Confirmed working in game by the user.

Automated Lua 5.1 compatibility and package checks passed. The installable ZIP excludes tests and development files.

## Install

Download [CleanerLootMessages-1.0.27.zip](https://github.com/luttman/CleanerLootMessages/releases/download/1.0.27/CleanerLootMessages-1.0.27.zip) from the release assets and extract the CleanerLootMessages folder into your client's Interface/AddOns directory.

This installable ZIP excludes tests and development files. GitHub's automatic **Source code (zip)** and **Source code (tar.gz)** downloads contain the repository, including tests; use the named addon ZIP for installation.
